description: Gold set for the spot-check judge (T-029). Each item is a box in an openly licensed photo, labelled person (on foot or cycling), in_vehicle (a person inside a vehicle) or not_person (anything else, including depictions of people), and degraded to TfL JamCam conditions by wearreport.tools.goldset. Source photos are downloaded by scripts/fetch_goldset.sh and never committed.

annotations.source: Boxes of Open Images V7 (validation and test subsets), some reshaped to a person-like window; boxes proposed by the YOLOX-m detector on the same photos; boxes drawn by hand for bollards. Every label and kind was assigned by visual review of the licensed photos.

kinds.in_vehicle: a person inside a road vehicle, seen through a window or an open top
kinds.pole: a lamp post, sign post, traffic-light pole or parking meter
kinds.bin: a litter bin or wheelie bin
kinds.sign: a road sign, shop sign or billboard
kinds.bollard: a bollard or a fire hydrant
kinds.depiction: a person on a poster, screen or advert, a statue, a mannequin or a toy figure
kinds.other: anything else the detector took for a person (clothes on a fence, a car seat, a window)

degradation.method: goldset.degrade: crop with the margin, INTER_AREA shrink to height_px, JPEG at jpeg_quality; parameters from goldset.degradation_params(seed, id)
